Data.why: World Bank indicator values per country and indicator, one column per year 1960 to 2011: yearly state held wide, a snapshot once pivoted long.

Metadata - Countries.why: One row per country keyed by Country Code with region, income group and notes; Data and target point at it.

Metadata - Indicators.why: 88 indicator codes with their name, source note and organisation, pointed at only by Data.

target.why: One 2012 value per country, keyed by Country Code: the one-period case, with the year in the column name.
